title: The rig, before and during
caption: Screenshots from the rig, in order: other people's tracks in 2025, then the roads built in 2026.

files.caption: McLaren Elva on LA Canyons, Assetto Corsa. One of 41 screenshots from January to March 2025, 38 of them McLarens.
McLaren P1 on LA Canyons, the same week as the abandoned McLaren Corsa site.
The full desktop before any software of its own: stock iRacing HUD on the 3440×1440 ultrawide, a READY card on the second display. Ten weeks before the first plugin commit.
Mazda Miata on the Nordschleife, the evening the track pipeline was scaffolded.
Lotus Evora in fog on a two-lane mountain road, Assetto Corsa, decoded from an HDR capture.
